newsitem.title: CANADA: QLT stock gains as drugs get publicity.
newsitem.headline: QLT stock gains as drugs get publicity.

text.p: QLT PhotoTherapeutics Inc shares climbed Monday amid publicity for the biotechnology company's light-activated drugs, QLT said.

The company said it was featured on a Canadian Broadcasting Corp business television program over the weekend and its executives were also participating Monday in a UBS Securities investment conference in New York.
QLT shares were up 2.20 to 27.70 in Toronto. QLT's main product, a light-activitated cancer drug called Photofrin, has been approved in several countries including the United States.
